entry.name: showButton
entry.label: When the top-bar button shows (a pen must exist): "tablet" (tablet posture), "always" or "never"

entry.name: actions
entry.label: The tiles of the pen menu, in order: newnote, snip, markup, whiteboard, drawonscreen, settings

entry.name: garageAction
entry.label: When the pen leaves its garage (only with the garage service): "menu", "newnote" or "none"

entry.name: openRequest
entry.label: Written by other shell parts through desktop scripting: "open:NONCE", "close:NONCE", "toggle:NONCE", "newnote:NONCE" or "settings:NONCE"

entry.name: forcePen
entry.label: Test sessions only: act as if a pen existed (virtual sessions have no tablet devices)
